body:
2026-08-06 session complete summary. Full record + SLS(113) source/ex4 + ledger attached as files.

10 warrants shipped tonight (#120-129), SLS(104)/10.18 -> SLS(113)/10.27, all compiled 0 errors, all diff-verified before deploy.

5 REAL BUGS found and fixed (not cosmetic):
1. Retry-engine + calibration-verdict logging was Print-only, invisible in real time -- root cause of two "is it frozen" scares tonight. Fixed (#120/121/125).
2. Phase 2's signalPF used the wrong regime-specific bracket for 7 of 9 regimes (#123).
3. 19 duplicated 2.5/1.5 ATR-bracket literals consolidated onto named constants (#122/123/126).
4. Live recentWinRate had a hardcoded /20.0 denominator -- understated your win rate for the first ~20 trades of every deployment, feeding straight into Kelly sizing (#124).
5. A live order-placement path (range trading) bypassed the hard 7.5% risk ceiling entirely -- not exploitable today but structurally unprotected (#127).

Also: rebuilt the standalone watchdog script (found missing, no backup existed), and built+enabled the champion auto-revert mechanism (#128/129) per your explicit go-ahead.

One terminal close was forensically root-caused: real Intel Wi-Fi driver hiccup + you closing it yourself -- not a TUNGSTEN bug.

Open: item #9 (Keys-3 decisive experiment) still needs a completed Phase 6 run -- RUN_20260806_1917 on SLS(113) is live right now, watching for it.
